text:
Mia: Heads-up 12h until Cascade announcement. We need final changelog blurb, prod docs URL, landing page link, inbound lead routing config, and confirmed canary timing so we can lock the email and blog header. Also need a 1-slide benchmark summary for the webinar deck.

Sam: Changelog PR is in: https://git.redwood.local/pr/491 
Snippet I propose:
- Cascade: smarter KV eviction (p99 latency ~18% lower on L96 tails)
- New int8 serving profile: ~2x token-cost reduction for many models
- Routing fallback stability fixes and observability improvements

Priya: Docs ready on staging: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/releases/cascade. I'll merge to prod after the canary completes. I'll also add migration notes for the int8 profile.

Jordan: For inbound leads, we need: webhook endpoint, campaign UTM set, and default owner mapping. Ops prefers Thu 09:30 PT for a 30m canary, then 1h ramp if metrics look good. Is that acceptable?

Alex: Webinar confirmed Fri 11:00 PT. Marketing needs that perf slide + a 2-sentence narrative for the host by EOD. Sam, can you provide the TL;DR numbers (latency, cost delta, stability) plus a short caveat about dataset-specific variance?

Sam: Running perf passes now across our L96 and typical chat traces. Expect a CSV + 3-bullet TL;DR in ~90 minutes. Will call out variance and which kernels were used.

Mia: Draft blurb for blog/email: "Cascade reduces p99 latency on long-context workloads by ~18% and lowers inference cost with an int8 serving profile (typical 2x cost improvement). See migration notes in docs." Thoughts?

Priya: Fine, but please add a short note about "results may vary by model architecture and workload". I'll add that into the docs copy.

Mia: Good call. Updated draft: "Cascade reduces p99 latency on long-context workloads by ~18% and lowers inference cost with the new int8 serving profile (typical 2x improvement). Results vary by model and input distribution; see docs for tuning tips."

Jordan: Routing example config (will post to #sales-integrations):
```
{ "campaign": "cascade-q1-2026", "utm_source": "announce_email", "webhook": "https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/capture", "defaults": { "owner": "growth-sales" } }
```
I'll DM the webhook secret to @Mia.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: Thu 2026-03-26T16:30:00Z. Window: 30m; auto-ramp to 1h if metrics stable. Triggered by Sam.

Sam: Ack. I'll attach the webhook to the release job and post metrics here. Watching p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and GPU utilization.

Jordan: Webhook secret DM'd to Mia. :white_check_mark:

Mia: Marketing will produce the email+blog draft for review by 5pm PT today. If Sam posts numbers earlier we'll inline the TL;DR and the one-slide perf graphic. Thanks y'all :rocket:
